Subject: operator algebras | ID: 15328

Proposition

Proof

Step 3. By the Lipschitz spectral theorem, we decompose \(P_{01310013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Lipschitz spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via Fourier interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01310011 \cdot C_01310012 \cdot C_01310013\).
